Noor Al-Farsi  
123 Maple Street, Austin, TX 78701 | noor.al-farsi@email.com | (512) 555-0198 | linkedin.com/in/nooralfarsi | github.com/nooralfarsi  

As a data scientist at HealthInsight Analytics, I focus on leveraging analytical rigor to enhance clinical decision-making. My work bridges technical expertise with healthcare domain knowledge, delivering actionable insights through scalable data solutions. Over the past year, I’ve contributed to projects that integrate natural language processing, statistical modeling, and database optimization to address challenges in patient care.  

At HealthInsight Analytics, I developed NLP models to extract structured insights from unstructured clinical notes, improving the accuracy of diagnostic risk assessments by 18% across a dataset of 50,000+ records. This involved preprocessing text with regex patterns, tokenization, and feature engineering to capture contextual relationships between symptoms and diagnoses. I also optimized SQL queries for EHR data aggregation, reducing query execution time by 25% and enabling real-time dashboards for clinicians.  

During my internship at MedTech Innovations, I built predictive models for patient readmission rates using scikit-learn, achieving a 12% improvement in model precision compared to baseline approaches. The models incorporated features like admission history and comorbidity indices, validated through cross-validation and deployed in a production environment. At VitalCare Solutions, I designed SQL pipelines to automate data aggregation from disparate sources, ensuring consistency in datasets used for cohort analysis and trend monitoring.  

My technical work relies heavily on Python, where I’ve utilized NumPy for array operations and Pandas for data transformation, enabling efficient handling of large-scale datasets. For visualization, I’ve employed Plotly to create interactive dashboards and Tableau for ad-hoc exploratory analysis, ensuring stakeholders can interpret results without requiring deep technical expertise.  

I hold a Master of Science in Data Science from the University of Manchester (2023), where my thesis focused on machine learning applications in predictive healthcare analytics. This academic background has informed my approach to problem-solving, emphasizing the importance of statistical validity and reproducibility in all projects.  

Certifications include the Data Science Certification from Coursera, which reinforced my understanding of algorithmic best practices and their application in real-world scenarios.  

Fluent in English and Arabic, I communicate technical concepts clearly to interdisciplinary teams, ensuring alignment between data outcomes and clinical objectives. My work remains grounded in measurable impact, with a focus on solutions that directly address gaps in healthcare data workflows.
